findings.finding: Launcher hard RLIMIT_CPU<=601 seconds is inherited by guardian. Frozen b985 sets payload RLIMIT_CPU in preexec but cannot raise inherited hard ceiling for e.g1800-second payload, causing preexec failure; guardian also inherits inappropriate self cap.
findings.requirement: Bound launcher CPU without passing a lowered hard CPU ceiling to guardian; explicit child restore may only restore limits still allowed by unchanged inherited hard cap. Verify own CPU/wall limit remains bounded.

findings.finding: Root source refs hashed only at initial config validation. A job without a ledger row returnsFalse before input hash checks, so later pending launches lack immediate source/worker/inputs revalidation.
findings.requirement: Immediately before each guardian launch, recheck all pinned source_refs and job input refs under the queue lock, and reject changed/missing/hash-placeholder materialized inputs.

findings.finding: Previously HEALTHY_CLOSED state result SHA is overwritten after a fresh body-based verification, without comparison to prior saved seal. Input metadata currently only parsed.
findings.requirement: Preserve and compare prior result/input/proof/manifest/payload artifact seals for already accepted jobs; never silently reseal changed historical results during skip.

findings.finding: Own wall budget is enforced using time.time epoch only; monotonic start is used only for reporting.
findings.requirement: Enforce a monotonic invocation wall bound alongside actual UTC expiry.

findings.finding: Only jobid and phase uniqueness checked; duplicate result directories/logs would fail only midqueue.
findings.requirement: Reject duplicate/overlapping result output identities and logs during config preflight.

scope: Static source only; no ledger read, numerical imports, Q, training, Git, queue execution or source edit. Parent author is already adding exception cleanup, resume status and early self-budget handling.
